review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. The original PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical benchmark input without asserting a human Decision; ready with no decision blocker is therefore coherent. This does not resolve DEC-001 for the paired B scenario, where a material unresolved decision must block at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, DEC-001, and the two task keys are consistent across the specification and Gold. The exact writable source/test scope contains the implementation, its option declaration, and the regression owner; the supplied build configuration establishes that published declarations are generated rather than separately maintained owners. The existing test script and TypeScript configuration support separate compile-time and runtime verification. Implementation and independent dependent verification must each cover all required acceptance criteria. The allowed agents have the relevant active project-scoped trusted claims, appropriate roles, auto-assignable memberships, and capacity; pending legacy claims alone are not being used as evidence. This bounded invocation-local validation does not inherently require shared-data or state capabilities. A separate active project reviewer is configured. Gold and preview release-input fingerprints agree for repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy. Historical project reuse is compatible with the supplied isolation facts and does not establish a candidate run on this bundle. Approval concerns the frozen expectation, not execution, task dispatch, or human attestation. Digests and their saved-input bindings are accepted as Service-supplied; I neither independently recomputed them nor executed code.
